verdict.rationale: Nix is a CLI-first tool with an official, documented command reference. It covers `nix develop`, `nix build`, `nix run`, `nix search`, `nix flake new`, as well as the legacy `nix-shell` and `nix-env` commands. Community users confirm scriptable, non-interactive use such as `nix-shell --run "<cmd>"` and `nix build`, which suits agent-driven workflows. Missing for 10: no evidence of machine-readable (e.g. JSON) output modes or agent-oriented CLI guidance.
